headline: Bitcoin is holding just under $60,000 after US tech stocks fell again, with new US tariffs expected soon and Wednesday's inflation report the next test before a Fed meeting where markets expect a rate hike.

stories.title: Bitcoin stays just under $60,000 as tech stocks fall and money keeps leaving bitcoin funds
stories.summary: Bitcoin gave back Monday's Nvidia-driven bounce and stayed just under $60,000 into Tuesday evening in the US. The Nasdaq fell about 1.5%, traders who borrowed to bet on higher prices were forced out, and US spot bitcoin funds have now lost money five days in a row. Analysts are watching June's low near $58,500.
points: At 5:55pm ET bitcoin was $59,931.93, down 2.09% over 24 hours, and ether $1,684.14, down 1.45%, per Business Upturn.
The Nasdaq closed down 1.45% at 23,740.52 and the S&P 500 down 0.48%, while the Dow rose 0.87%, per Reuters via MarketScreener.
About $844 million of crypto futures bets were force-closed in 24 hours, $357 million of them in bitcoin, per CoinDesk.
US spot bitcoin funds lost $569.7 million on Monday 23 Nov, led by BlackRock's IBIT at $509.3 million, per The Block; November's outflows of about $4.71 billion are a monthly record, per CoinDesk.
Glassnode said a close below the June low of $58,500 could point toward bitcoin's "realized price" of about $53,200, per CoinDesk.

stories.title: US expected to announce new tariffs on 16 trading partners
stories.summary: Reuters reported that the US government is about to publish the results of an investigation into "excess industrial capacity" in 16 economies, followed by new import taxes. As of the latest reports it had not been announced.
points: The 16 economies include China, the EU, India, Japan, South Korea, Mexico, Vietnam and Taiwan, per Reuters via the Korea Times.
Existing trade deals cap duties at 15% for the EU, Japan and South Korea, and the White House is expected to honor them, per Reuters via Yahoo Finance.
A trade lawyer at King & Spalding suggested rates of 15% to 25%, per Reuters via Yahoo Finance.
The new duties would partly replace tariffs the Supreme Court struck down in February; the US-China trade truce runs out on 10 January, per Reuters via the Korea Times.

sources.label: Reuters via Yahoo Finance: Trump administration set to unveil tariffs
Reuters via Korea Times: US poised to unveil new tariffs

stories.title: Wednesday's inflation report lands as markets expect the Fed to raise rates in December
stories.summary: October's PCE inflation report, the Fed's preferred inflation measure, comes out Wednesday at 8:30am ET (20:30 Bangkok), along with a revised Q3 growth figure. Traders now expect the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates at its 9 December decision. Higher rates tend to weigh on risky assets like crypto.
points: October PCE prices are expected to rise 0.3% on the month and 3.8% on the year, after 0.5% and 3.6% in September, per FinanceCalendar.
Fed funds futures priced about a 95% chance of a quarter-point hike on 9 Dec as of 24 Nov, per CoinOtag.
New York Fed President John Williams signaled support for higher rates but did not appear to back Governor Waller's push for a half-point hike, per CoinDesk.
The Fed's decision is Wed 9 Dec at 2:00pm ET (02:00 Thu Bangkok), per the Federal Reserve.

briefs.title: SEC staff gives Molecule no-action relief
briefs.summary: The SEC's Corporation Finance staff said it will not recommend enforcement over Molecule's science-research project tokens, adding to recent no-action letters for DoubleZero, Fuse and Canton, per The Block.

briefs.title: CleanSpark reports its fiscal-year results
briefs.summary: The bitcoin miner reported fourth-quarter revenue of $120.9 million, down 46% on the year, a full-year net loss of $987.1 million, and 13,530 BTC held, per its SEC filing.

briefs.title: Binance pauses withdrawals for maintenance on Wednesday
briefs.summary: Withdrawals on all networks pause from 06:00 UTC Wed 25 Nov (13:00 Bangkok) for about 60 minutes; trading is not affected, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: CFTC lets derivatives firms count crypto toward reserves
briefs.summary: A CFTC staff advisory lets exchanges and clearinghouses count bitcoin and ether (with a 20% haircut) and qualifying stablecoins (2%) toward operating-cost reserves, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: Strategy stock hits its lowest since early 2024
briefs.summary: Strategy (MSTR) fell to an intraday low of $77.89 on Tuesday, its lowest since early 2024, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: $2.57 million drained from trader Ansem's wallet
briefs.summary: A suspected attacker moved $2.57 million in USDC out of memecoin trader Ansem's wallet and his Black Bull coin fell 55%; Ansem denies involvement, per The Block.
